title: Cold Metal
description: "Cold Metal" focuses on the stark aesthetic of industrial materials and the socio-historical tension embedded within them. Through large-scale metal sculptures, kinetic machinery, and repurposed industrial relics, the exhibition highlights the contrast between technological ambition and humanistic reflection through a rigid, unyielding medium. Amid the interplay of metallic textures and light, it critically reflects on how industrialization shapes and reconstructs human emotion, urban landscapes, and future existence.
